description: This Java source file contains the implementation of the ProductImageDao interface, specifically the ProductImageDaoImpl class. It manages database operations related to ProductImage entities, including retrieving product images by ID using QueryDSL for ORM queries.

classes.name: ProductImageDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of data access object for product images, extending generic entity DAO and implementing ProductImageDao. Provides method to retrieve product images by ID.

methods.name: getProductImageById
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductImage entity from the database using its ID, constructing a query with QueryDSL to perform joins and fetch associated descriptions and the related product.
